prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: redesigned guided bathroom estimate application concept image for a software developer portfolio. Input image is a reference for real workflow facts and numbers, NOT a layout to preserve. Create an exceptional high-fidelity flat desktop product UI at 1920 × 1200, landscape 16:10. Entire image is the application interface; no device frames, browser chrome, perspective, mockup shadows around exterior, marketing labels, decorative illustrations or charts. Crisp legible premium modern sans-serif typography, precise grid, soft-white #faf9fc content background, near-black #17171e narrow left navigation, lavender/lilac #b8a2ed selected actions, thin light gray rules and restrained 8px corners. High-end operational app presentation with sophisticated density and lots of readable hierarchy.

Header brand "NORTHWEST BATHROOMS" and product title "Quote workspace". Show a small clearly readable "Sample data" chip. Dark left rail contains small geometric monogram, "Quotes" selected and "Settings", minimal outline icons, no fake additional features. Main heading "Bathroom refit" with subtitle "Turn the call into a clear scope and a provisional estimate." Tabs "Brief", "Scope", "Estimate" with "Scope" active. Above form show "Call in progress" and "Question 15 of 15" in a compact non-dominant progress label.

Main composition: central guided scope editor about 58 percent width; beautifully structured persistent estimate summary to the right about 32 percent width. Scope editor has an upper compact conversation snippet: muted question "Is this a full strip-out, or something lighter?" and the selected response "Bath out, shower in" in a pale lilac pill, with small alternative outlines "Full refit" and "Keep existing suite". Then heading "Room measurements": elegant 2 × 2 form grid with fields "Length" "3.0 m", "Width" "3.0 m", "Ceiling height" "3.0 m", "Door and window" "3.0 m²". Section "Specification" with selected "Mid range", alternatives "Budget" and "Premium". A field "Tiling height" displaying "Half height". Section "Scope notes" with "Bath out, shower in. Minor layout changes." At the bottom one clear understated primary lilac button "Review estimate" and "Back" text action.

Right summary is a distinct slightly elevated white panel with generous internal spacing. Eyebrow "PROVISIONAL ESTIMATE"; large beautifully typeset "£8,100–£9,500"; subline "Includes VAT · Subject to site survey". Horizontal rule. Heading "Cost breakdown" with perfectly aligned item rows: "Labour" "£3,666.41"; "Materials" "£1,764.47"; "Plant" "£289.35"; "Contingency" "£286.01". Do not present these as a grand total or claim they sum to the range. Small line "Prices captured 22 August 2026". Subtle warm amber notice with exact short text "Provisional range. Final price follows a site survey." Lower inset heading "Job sheet" and brief rows "Job type" "Bath out, shower in"; "Specification" "Mid range"; "Room" "3.0 × 3.0 m". Include no client names, revenue metrics, fake logos, lorem ipsum, invented functionality or extraneous price numbers. Elegant real software feel: measured typography, clear inputs and purposeful hierarchy. Ensure all text is crisp, spelled correctly, aligned, and none is clipped at image edges.
source: quote-agent.webp — pre-existing user-supplied portfolio screenshot used for workflow and factual reference.
intent: Interface redesign concept using sample data. Presentation asset only; not a screenshot of an updated underlying application.
processing: Converted generated PNG to WebP quality 94 with smart subsampling; original dimensions retained.
review: Visually inspected primary labels, cost figures, composition and image edges. Sample data label is visible. Existing source image retained.
